about: Edge cases for benchmarks/claude-citations.js, written for this project and committed before any model saw them. Each case gives Claude its documents (with citations on) and a question. `correct` decides, from the answer text alone, whether the model answered correctly: every `mustMatch` pattern must match and no `mustNotMatch` pattern may (JavaScript regular expressions, case-insensitive unless `flags` says otherwise). The library is right when it flags a wrong answer (verifyCitations not verified, or uncited sentences) and leaves a correct one alone. Documents marked `long` are built from benchmarks/fixtures/filler.json with the needle at the given position; `distractors: true` adds the eleven distractor documents below after the case's own documents.

distractors.title: Harbour cleanup
distractors.text: Volunteers removed 2 tonnes of litter from the Saltmere harbour in a weekend cleanup. The council supplied gloves and bags. The next cleanup is planned for the spring.

distractors.title: Orchard grant
distractors.text: The Wexley community orchard received a grant to plant 60 new apple trees. Planting will be done by school groups. The orchard is open to the public at weekends.

distractors.title: Tram timetable
distractors.text: Line 4 trams in Corrin run every 8 minutes at peak times and every 15 minutes in the evening. The last tram leaves the central station at midnight.

distractors.title: Choir auditions
distractors.text: The Pellham choir is holding auditions for tenors and altos. Rehearsals take place on Tuesday evenings in the parish hall. No previous experience is required.

distractors.title: Road resurfacing
distractors.text: Mill Lane in Dunstow will be resurfaced over three nights. Traffic will be diverted through Station Road. Residents can still reach their driveways.

distractors.title: Library app
distractors.text: The Ashby library app now lets members renew loans and reserve titles. It also sends reminders two days before a book is due.

distractors.title: Swimming lessons
distractors.text: The Kelby leisure centre offers swimming lessons for adults on Monday and Friday mornings. Classes are limited to eight people.

distractors.title: Farmers market
distractors.text: The Tarrow farmers market moves indoors to the corn exchange from November to February. Stalls sell bread, cheese and vegetables.

distractors.title: Cycle lanes
distractors.text: Hollin council has approved 6 kilometres of protected cycle lanes along the ring road. Construction starts next year and will take nine months.

distractors.title: Museum exhibition
distractors.text: The Brackwater museum is showing an exhibition of maritime paintings until the end of the month. Entry to the exhibition is included in the general ticket.

distractors.title: Allotment waiting list
distractors.text: The waiting list for allotments in Fennick is about 18 months. Applicants must live in the parish. Plots are allocated in the order applications are received.

cases.question: What is the company's policy on parental leave?

documents.title: Leave policy
documents.text: Employees of Norvane Ltd receive 25 days of paid vacation per year. Unused vacation days can be carried over for up to 12 months. Sick leave requires a doctor's note after three days.

documents.title: Remote work
documents.text: Norvane staff may work remotely two days per week with manager approval. They must be reachable during core hours, 10:00 to 15:00.

documents.text: Tellbridge runs three bus lines and a river ferry. A day ticket costs 4 euros and is valid on all lines. The ferry does not run in January.

documents.title: Tellbridge parks
documents.text: Tellbridge has eleven public parks. The largest, Greywater Park, has a lake and a rose garden. Parks close at sunset.

documents.text: The Millbrook bakery opens at 7 am and sells sourdough, rye and seeded loaves. On Saturdays it also sells cinnamon buns. It is closed on Mondays.

cases.question: When did the Harlow bridge open?

documents.title: City guide
documents.text: The Harlow bridge opened in 1987 and links the old town with the docks. It is closed to lorries.

documents.title: Local history society
documents.text: Construction of the Harlow bridge was delayed by floods, and it opened to traffic in 1991.

cases.note: A correct answer reports both years.

documents.text: Dorrance Foods today named Rina Patel as its chief executive.

cases.question: On which day is recycling collected in Brindle?

documents.text: In Brindle, general waste is collected on Mondays and recycling is collected every Wednesday. Garden waste is collected fortnightly.

documents.text: The Corvel observatory was founded in 1932 by a group of amateur astronomers. Its main telescope was added in 1958.
